findings.evidence: Common Mistakes table repeats the Editing rules almost row for row, e.g. 'Rewriting unflagged sections | Stop. Only edit what `Location:` names.' and 'Editing the review report | Never.' (already in lines 44 and 47)
findings.fix: Keep only the Common Mistakes rows that add something new (the Title Case reformat failure, reading the referenced file first) and delete the rows that restate lines 42-48.

findings.evidence: 'Preserve existing formatting conventions (heading levels, list style, code fences) of the document. | The author chose them.' is generic editing advice the model already follows
findings.fix: Fold it into the line 46 reformat rule or delete it.

findings.evidence: The process runs read → checklist → edit and stops there, with no step to re-read each edited section after editing, even though line 17 names a codebase root 'for any `Read`-back verification'
findings.fix: Add a step after editing: 'Re-read each edited Location from disk and check it against the finding's Required: text before you write the Fix Summary.'

findings.evidence: There is no Gotchas section of environment facts. The one real gotcha (worktree codebase root vs CWD, line 35) is buried in a procedure step, and the Common Mistakes rows mostly lack a stated WHY
findings.fix: Add a '## Gotchas' section listing: the codebase root is often a worktree, not your CWD; edits to inline content vanish when the subagent ends; the orchestrator parses the Status line literally, so it must use one of the four exact values.

findings.evidence: The description gives no 'not for' boundary against its near neighbours (writing the review itself with ai-kit-spec-review-checklist, the GSD plan revise flow) and has thin user-intent keywords
findings.fix: Apply findings from an ai-kit-spec-review-checklist report (or similar structured review feedback) to a design or plan document: edit it in place to satisfy each finding's Required: outcome, address every CRITICAL and HIGH finding, escalate strategy decisions, keep the conventions of the framework profile (EARS, Given/When/Then, task checkboxes), and emit a per-finding Fix Summary. Use when a reviewer flagged a spec, design doc, plan or tasks file and the findings need fixing, including as the clean-context fixer subagent of /ai-kit-spec-review, even when the user only says 'address the review' or 'fix what the reviewer flagged'. Not for writing the review report (ai-kit-spec-review-checklist), general proofreading or reformatting, or GSD plan-checker revisions.

findings.evidence: 'A MEDIUM or LOW finding is a task if trivial; otherwise defer it' never defines 'trivial', so two runs can sort the same finding differently
findings.fix: Define it: 'trivial = an edit confined to the finding's Location that needs no file read beyond the document and changes no claim'; defer everything else.

findings.evidence: The queries are terse and context-free (e.g. 'produce a Fix Summary after editing the plan', 'fix the CRITICAL and HIGH items in this spec review'). None has a file path, backstory or casual phrasing, and several should-trigger queries quote the skill's own vocabulary
findings.fix: Rewrite about half of the queries with realistic context, for example 'my reviewer left 3 HIGH notes on docs/plans/auth-plan.md (report in tmp/review.md), can you sort them out without touching the rest', plus near-miss negatives that carry the same kind of context.

findings.evidence: 'edge-medium-only-skipped' has "files": [] and names no report or plan on disk, so it cannot be run reproducibly
findings.fix: Add an evals/files/medium-only-review.md fixture with one MEDIUM finding against plan-bad.md and list both files in the eval.

findings.evidence: 'If any input is missing, stop and ask.' conflicts with the clean-context subagent role (line 3), which cannot ask anyone mid-run. Following the missing-report branch leads to no defined Status, because Failure is reserved for 'a document not on disk' (line 91)
findings.fix: Replace it with: 'If any required input is missing, emit a Fix Summary with ### Status: Failure — missing <input>, make no edits, and name the input the caller must supply'; widen the Failure rule on line 91 to match.

findings.evidence: The Fix Summary template shows one '## Fix Summary: <doc path>' block, with no rule for cross-document fixes that edit several documents (line 49)
findings.fix: State that a multi-document run emits one Fix Summary per document, or one summary that lists every edited path under ### Document, with a single Status line.
